svg.title: AREA 28
svg.desc: Everyone takes 1→1′. One enters the nine-barrier maze while the other three press 1–8 in order, then 1 again. Efficient split: one player handles 1/7/5, one 3/6, and one 2/4/8; the maze player activates the center switch. False-wall box rooms contain Zonde traps. Skip without a sword, partisan or Gizonde, then use 2→2′ and 3→3′.
